Author: Stefano Garzarella <sgarzare@redhat.com>

    vsock: handle buffer_size sockopts in the core

bic_trace_step.reason: The commit introduces the `vsock_update_buffer_size()` function (lines 1379-1394) which contains the vulnerable logic. Specifically, it clamps `val` to `vsk->buffer_max_size` first (lines 1383-1384) and then to `vsk->buffer_min_size` (lines 1386-1387). If a user sets `buffer_min_size` to a value larger than `buffer_max_size`, the second check will override the first check, allowing `vsk->buffer_size` to exceed `vsk->buffer_max_size`.
